content: plugin.json lives at .claude-plugin/plugin.json (optional file; if absent Claude Code auto-discovers). Only required field is name (kebab-case). Optional: displayName, version (semver, pins updates), description, author{name,email,url}, homepage, repository, license, keywords, metadata (free-form), skills/commands/agents/workflows/hooks/mcpServers/outputStyles/lspServers (component path overrides), userConfig, channels, dependencies. commands/agents/workflows/outputStyles REPLACE default dir scan; skills ADDS to it. Unrecognized fields ignored (warning only, --strict makes them errors). Source: code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference (fetched directly), corroborated by community search results.
